lines.speaker: cultist_pilgrim
lines.text: Wait! Please. Not all of us want to go where they are going.

lines.speaker: cultist_pilgrim
lines.text: I can cook. I can weld. I can stop chanting. Mostly.

lines.speaker: cultist_pilgrim
lines.text: The grey world is not a destination. It is an appointment. I do not wish to keep it.

lines.speaker: cultist_pilgrim
lines.text: Nothing! I carry nothing. Only regret, and a small ceremonial knife. For fruit.

lines.speaker: cultist_pilgrim
lines.text: Take me with you, and I will work for my passage. You will not regret it.

lines.speaker: cultist_pilgrim
lines.text: Thank you. I can work. I can keep quiet. I can even stop chanting when people are sleeping.

lines.speaker: cultist_pilgrim
lines.text: I understand. Please go before they notice I asked.

options.line: Why are you running from your own people?
All right. You're coming with us.
No. I'm not taking the risk.
